intro: Every change has **3 stages**: **1 · Report** (Human tells it, Opus writes the action item in its roadmap and asks: write the prompt now?), **2 · Plan** (options or a plan if the type needs one, then the prompt uses lower agents: Sonnet codes, Haiku runs fixed commands; all questions are asked here, one item at a time), **3 · Execute** (the work, from the before screenshots). Start with **/do**: Claude asks the type and how far to go. Prompts not written yet are written at the night run's prompt planning (A).

rules.title: Never wake Human
rules.text: decide alone and write the decision in the summary.

rules.title: Blockers
rules.text: remove them yourself (a stuck emulator or test driver); what truly needs Human goes in the summary with the exact command.

rules.title: Never tonight
rules.text: carrying out infrastructure (plan only), visual changes Human hasn't chosen, features whose plan isn't approved, deploys beyond the test environment, merging the PR.

rules.title: Don't loop
rules.text: same failure after a fix, or 4 rounds → write it down, move on.

rules.title: No new items
rules.text: new failures and ideas go under "Proposed items"; Human decides.

always.title: UI change
always.text: **before and after** screenshots of each changed screen, on every platform the project has. Sonnet takes them locally (before = before coding; e2e saves the after shots). They go into the release notes, next to the change.

always.title: Motion counts
always.text: when the change is about motion (a sheet opening, an animation, a transition), also save a short **MP4** (3–5 s, 300px wide, 30 fps) of the moment, before and after, next to the screenshots in the release notes.

always.title: Diagrams
always.text: one column per part (e.g. app, API, database); never "server".

always.title: Human's task → roadmap
always.text: a task from Human goes into the roadmap without asking; a question just gets an answer; "research X" becomes a roadmap task, not research now.

always.title: Never add items alone
always.text: follow-ups, ideas and new failures are proposed with context; Human decides.

always.title: Propose first
always.text: anything outside the current step is proposed and approved before it's done, never after.

always.title: Bug repro order
always.text: unit/integration, then e2e on the quickest platform, then the other platforms only when it can't reproduce it there. An e2e that already fails is the repro: don't add another.

always.title: Roadmap marks
always.text: "+ [ ]" has a prompt, "- [ ]" has none yet. Before Sonnet works, every "-" item gets a prompt or a reason it's manual.

always.title: Checks before a commit
always.text: typecheck, lint, tests and the project's other fast checks, real output reported; docs-only changes skip all checks.

always.title: New rules
always.text: Claude shows the change to this page for Human to approve, instead of adding memories quietly. When how we work changes, this page changes too.
